text: Ethiopian federal forces have retaken Mekelle airport and seized the Tigray capital, per events logged Oct 4. A day earlier Tigrayan forces were reported falling back. No casualty figures have been released by either side.

judge.comment: Major development, but the tracker holds a single day of reporting; a human should confirm sourcing before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Federal forces retook Mekelle airport and seized Tigray's capital
Tigrayan forces reported falling back on Oct 3
No casualty figures released by either side
factChecks.source: Tracker lists no casualty figures for this event; absence of release not independently confirmed

text: Bundibugyo Ebola, as of Oct 2: 8,397 confirmed cases and 4,044 deaths (8,376 and 4,042 in DRC). North Kivu accounts for nearly 40% of newly confirmed cases. 63 health zones across seven DRC provinces are affected.

judge.comment: Figures match the tracker digest and KPIs with as-of date stated.

factChecks.claim: 8,397 confirmed cases, 4,044 deaths as of Oct 2
North Kivu nearly 40% of newly confirmed cases

text: How many Yemeni government troops died in the Aug 6 Marib/Hadramout offensive? The government confirmed at least 30. An unnamed military source told AFP the toll may have reached 58. The Houthis claimed 45. Three figures, no independent count.

judge.comment: Contested-figure tweets never auto-approve; attribution matches the tracker's disputed-figures entry.

factChecks.claim: Military source told AFP toll may have reached 58

factChecks.source: Inferred from the tracker listing only these three sources

text: UN human rights officials report at least 5,700 people killed or wounded in Haiti's gang crisis so far this year, with more than 1,000 women and girls raped and 230 kidnappings recorded. Reported Oct 2; the UN Security Council extended the Gang Suppression Force mandate to March 2027.

judge.comment: All figures drawn from the tracker digest and events with UN attribution and dates.

factChecks.claim: At least 5,700 killed or wounded this year
More than 1,000 women and girls raped, 230 kidnappings
UNSC extended GSF mandate to March 2027
